q: What does W + R > N buy?
a: Overlap: every read quorum intersects every write quorum, so reads can find the latest write.

q: Why does write latency step with the concern?
a: Each tier waits on a slower replica: one answers at the fastest lag, all at the slowest.

q: When do reads go stale under quorums?
a: When they land on a replica the write hasn't reached — spread reads over lagged replicas and watch.
